content_sections.text: NGEL has announced vacancies for various Engineer and Executive positions. The post-wise vacancy details are given below:

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for NTPC Green Energy Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates having the required educational qualifications and experience can apply for different posts. The eligibility details are as follows: Engineer Posts: Candidates with B.E./B.Tech in relevant engineering disciplines and required work experience. Executive (Human Resources): Candidates with relevant HR qualification and experience. Executive (Finance): Candidates with Finance-related qualifications and required experience. Executive (CSR): Candidates with relevant qualification and experience in CSR field. Executive (Rajbhasha): Candidates with relevant language qualification and experience.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NTPC Green Energy Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official NGEL website. Go to the Career section. Read the official notification carefully. Click on the online application link. Register with your email ID and mobile number. Fill in all required details in the application form. Upload necessary documents. Submit the application form before the last date. Take a printout of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the name of the organization conducting NTPC Green Energy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: NTPC Green Energy Limited (NGEL), a subsidiary of NTPC Limited, is conducting the recruitment drive for Engineer and Executive posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in NTPC Green Energy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 147 vacancies are available for various Engineer and Executive positions under NGEL Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Engineer (RE-Civil), Engineer (RE-Electrical), Engineer (RE-Mechanical), Engineer (RE-Safety), Executive (RE-Human Resources), Executive (RE-Finance), Executive (RE-CSR) and Executive (RE-Rajbhasha).

faq.question: Q4. What is the starting date to apply for NTPC Green Energy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process will start from 18 August 2026 at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to apply for NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 07 September 2026 up to 06:00 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for NTPC Green Energy Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have relevant qualifications such as B.E./B.Tech, MBA or other required degrees depending on the post applied for.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for NGEL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts is 35 years. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Government rules.
